Ronseal 5 Year Fence Life+ Shed and Fence Protector 9ltr in charcoal grey offers durable wood protection for sheds and fences, ensuring longevity and a rich colour finish. This water-based shed and fence protector is designed for easy application on both rough sawn and smooth planed timber, even when damp. It provides 5 years of protection against rain, frost, and snow, maintaining its colour without peeling or flaking. The first coat protects, and the second coat seals, making it showerproof in just one hour. Suitable for new or previously stained with a similar colour wood, it can be applied with a brush or fence sprayer, ideal for professional landscapers and property maintenance.
b: Suitable for Rough, Damp or Smooth Wood
